name: kettlebell single arm overhead lunge
description: Lunge while holding one kettlebell locked out overhead. The overhead load challenges balance, shoulder stability and the legs.
instructions: Press a kettlebell overhead with one arm and keep that arm straight.
Step forward into a lunge and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your ribs down and the weight stacked over your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch the kettlebell to the other arm.
